A decision is a close choice when the second most likely play has at least half the probability of the first (internally: split).
Probabilities over plays, not sampled reasoning. Method

blocks.p: At the 0.02 margin a Risk pays position has a stake of at least 0.02, so the small band is empty. A big stake means playing safe costs more by the engine's value, not that the decision was harder.
